hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);const f=j.tool_response?.filePath||j.tool_input?.file_path;if(f)process.stdout.write(f)})" | { read -r f; if echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$'; then npx eslint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; }
